test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the ultimate goal of the BRICS Think Tank Council?

options.text: To establish a common currency for BRICS nations
To provide research-based insights for shaping BRICS Summit discussions and policies
To regulate trade policies among BRICS countries
To manage cultural exchanges among BRICS nations

solution:
The correct answer is __**To provide research-based insights for shaping BRICS Summit discussions and policies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **BRICS Think Tank Council (BTTC)** was officially established during the **5th BRICS Summit** held in **Durban, South Africa**, in **March 2013**. Its primary mandate is to serve as a platform for **Track II diplomacy**, facilitating exchange between academic and policy-making communities of the member nations.
 
• The ultimate goal of the council is to provide **research-based insights** and **strategic recommendations** to the BRICS leaders. This helps in identifying common interests, resolving potential conflicts, and shaping the agenda for the annual **BRICS Summits**.
 
• It functions as a coordinating body for the think tanks of the member countries, which include **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**. Each country designates a lead institution, such as the **Observer Research Foundation (ORF)** in **India** and the **Institute for Applied Economic Research (IPEA)** in **Brazil**.
